# Channel mixer

Builds each output channel from a weighted mix of the input red, green and blue: swap channels, fake infrared, or make a custom black and white.

<EffectDemo effect="channel-mixer" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { channelMixer } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/channel-mixer';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(channelMixer({ preset: 'swapRedBlue' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.red = [1, 0, 0]`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter           | Type      | Default     | Range  | Description                                                  |
| ------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `red`               | [x, y, z] | `[1, 0, 0]` | -2 – 2 | How much input red, green and blue go into the output red.   |
| `green`             | [x, y, z] | `[0, 1, 0]` | -2 – 2 | How much input red, green and blue go into the output green. |
| `blue`              | [x, y, z] | `[0, 0, 1]` | -2 – 2 | How much input red, green and blue go into the output blue.  |
| `monochrome`        | boolean   | `false`     |        | Use the red row for every channel: a black and white mix.    |
| `preserveLuminance` | boolean   | `false`     |        | Keep each pixel’s brightness after mixing.                   |
| `amount`            | number    | `1`         | 0 – 1  | Mix between the original and the remixed image.              |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset          | Settings                                                                                              |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `swapRedBlue`   | `red: [0, 0, 1]`, `blue: [1, 0, 0]`                                                                   |
| `infrared`      | `red: [-0.2, 1.5, -0.3]`, `green: [0.2, 0.7, 0.1]`, `blue: [0.9, -0.3, 0.4]`                          |
| `redFilterMono` | `monochrome: true`, `red: [0.9, 0.2, -0.1]`                                                           |
| `vintage`       | `red: [0.9, 0.15, 0]`, `green: [0.05, 0.85, 0.1]`, `blue: [0.1, 0.2, 0.6]`, `preserveLuminance: true` |

Apply one with `channelMixer({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.13 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/channel-mixer`, including the shared effect runtime.
